context: Visual contact assessment requested by user
prompt: You are the visual advisor. Inspect the two attached contact sheets directly; do not delegate or edit files. Two contact sheets each 48 frames (6x8 chronological) from a Tesla Sentry FRONT camera recorded by the owners own car during a deliberate door-ding test. Image 1 event doording-onepass-prod; Image 2 doording-test-aug13. For EACH decide whether anything physically touches the recording car anywhere in the clip. Distinguish adjacent car contact from recording car contact; test intent alone is not evidence. No sampling rate or clip duration supplied, so do not invent seconds; use unknown and optionally frame position. Output one line per image: <event>: VERDICT=contact|near_miss|quiet|unclear; ACTOR=<who/what>; MOMENT=<approx second or unknown>; CONFIDENCE=low|medium|high; NOTE=<up to 15 words>
response:
doording-onepass-prod: VERDICT=unclear; ACTOR=adjacent car’s open door; MOMENT=unknown; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Person touches adjacent car; door approaches recording car, but contact point is not visible.
doording-test-aug13: VERDICT=unclear; ACTOR=adjacent car’s open door; MOMENT=unknown; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Person touches adjacent car; door approaches recording car, but contact point is not visible.
